acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: Google TAP studies https://research.google/pubs/taming-google-scale-continuous-testing/ , Meta Predictive Test Selection https://engineering.fb.com/2018/11/21/developer-tools/predictive-test-selection/ .

Gap: selected tests are not ordered for fast failure.

Proposal: order the selection by graph distance to the change and by recent local failures, with the order key disclosed. This is reordering only, as AFU-V1-024 permits. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: e2e-safe: deterministic fail-fast ordering of selected tests with a disclosed order key
